units.source_text: 秋季决定京官任免，名曰“司召”。

en.t: In autumn, appointments and dismissals of officials in the capital were decided; this was called the Office Summons.

units.source_text: 春季决定地方官任免，名曰“县召”。

en.t: In spring, appointments and dismissals of provincial officials were decided; this was called the Provincial Summons.
